headline: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

meeting.body: Maui County Council Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee
meeting.voteItem: Main motion on Bill 131 (2026) as amended
meeting.summary: The committee recommended three emergency donation bills, heard about a new Philippine sister city, and reviewed the emergency fund.
meeting.recap: The Council adopted a sister city resolution on September 29, 2026, for a city in Ilocos Norte, Philippines.[[0:15:26]] The sister city item was deferred, or set aside for later.[[0:56:30]] The chair said three bills on money donated during an emergency would require quarterly reports to the Council.[[0:58:48]] The committee recommended Bill 131 as amended.[[1:17:29]] An administration official said no more emergency fund requests are expected right now.[[1:24:43]] An administration official said about $78 million remains in the fund.[[1:30:21]] The emergency fund item was deferred.[[2:06:41]]
decided: The committee deferred the sister city discussion.
The committee recommended passage of Bill 131 as amended.
meeting.next: An administrator said they will work with departments on an itemized emergency fund spending breakdown.

boards.name: Budget, Finance, and Economic Development Committee

issues.oneLine: The committee reviewed spending from the county's emergency fund after recent disasters.
issues.why: An administration official said disasters often bring significant costs, especially for infrastructure.
issues.next: An administrator will work with departments on an itemized spending breakdown.
issues.brief: Since March, the Council has authorized $42 million from the emergency fund.[[#1]] About $78 million remains in the fund, an administration official said.[[#2]] A council member said debris removal is one of the largest costs.[[#3]] Debris removal is done by Public Works and island contractors together.[[#4]]
